proposal.title: Convert SSG General Ledger — vanilla CP/M / CBASIC edition to technology-style specification chapters
proposal.reason: Preserve every existing specification description, relationship role and referenced ID in numbered chapters with named text parameters. Add the commercial offering kind and documented providers. Where supplied, release is a direct date already stated in the product or the supported Model II customer-release event. No sales forecasts or new standards-impact assessments are invented.

before.name: SSG General Ledger — vanilla CP/M / CBASIC edition
before.description: SSG’s independently published General Ledger for ordinary 8080/Z80 CP/M systems, released on 15 January 1978. CBASIC compiles source to intermediate code executed by its runtime interpreter; this is not native Z80 compilation. The accounting environment provides 14-digit arithmetic. The exact General Ledger revision, CBASIC compiler revision and runtime revision are unspecified. It needs no Aurelia ROM TUI and remains a separately maintained product and the functional reference for the Aurelia port.

specification.description: SSG publishes, licenses and supports the original CBASIC application.
